info.title: Mercaria public API
info.description: Commerce reads and authenticated donated-material reservations for Oxy applications. Success bodies are the value itself; every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`. Lists are `{ items, nextCursor }` and end at 10000 items. Generated from `@mercaria/contracts`; `@mercaria.co/sdk` is the supported client.
